heading.zh-Hant: 出身與獵兵時期
heading.en: Origins and the Jäger years

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭瑞典語傳記辭典（BLF）條目，卡爾·稜哈特·奧伊什1892年8月8日生於維堡省的皮海耶爾維。他在大學研讀植物學，1915年2月隨第一批志願者前往德國接受獵兵訓練，1916年參加米斯河戰鬥，並於1918年2月隨獵兵主力返回芬蘭。回國後他以志願兵在索爾塔瓦拉組建第8獵兵營，參與東部邊境附近的戰事，包括勞圖與拉蘇利。
body.en: According to the Biografiskt lexikon för Finland (BLF), Karl Lennart Oesch was born on 8 August 1892 at Pyhäjärvi in Viborg province. He studied botany at the university, went to Germany with the first volunteer contingent in February 1915 for Jäger training, fought in the battles at the river Misse in 1916 and came to Finland with the main Jäger force in February 1918. There he raised the 8th Jäger Battalion at Sortavala with volunteers and took part in fighting near the eastern border, including Rautu and Raasuli.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：學院、師長與參謀總長
heading.en: Interwar: War College, division and chief of the general staff

body.zh-Hant: BLF記載，奧伊什1920年獲任維堡團團長，1923至1926年奉派赴法國研習，1926年任戰爭學院院長，1929年任第1師師長。1930年秋季K·M·瓦倫紐斯因故被迫辭去參謀總長，奧伊什接任，並此後整整十年不間斷任此職，直到冬季戰爭結束；其間他也是國防委員會成員。
body.en: The BLF records that Oesch was given command of the Viborg regiment in 1920, was sent to France for studies in 1923–1926, became head of the War College in 1926 and commander of the 1st Division in 1929. When K. M. Wallenius was forced to resign as chief of the general staff in autumn 1930, Oesch was appointed in his place and held the post without interruption for a decade, until the end of the Winter War; he was also a member of the Defence Council.

heading.zh-Hant: 1932年短暫的副內政部長與冬季戰爭
heading.en: The 1932 deputy ministry and the Winter War

body.zh-Hant: 1932年3月，總統斯文胡武德任命奧伊什在馬恩特薩拉叛亂期間出任負責警務的副內政部長，接替3月4日辭職的尼洛·索爾雅，他在3月14日便辭職，是共和國任期最短的部長。冬季戰爭期間他以總司令的參謀總長身分實施戰前擬定的防禦計畫；戰爭尾聲他一度兼任前線指揮，並接掌海岸集群、在最後幾天穩定戰線。之後他在冬季戰爭與繼續戰爭之間任第二軍團集群司令，駐拉赫蒂。
body.en: In March 1932 President Svinhufvud appointed Oesch deputy minister of the interior for police matters during the Mäntsälä rebellion, in place of Niilo Solja, who had resigned on 4 March; Oesch resigned on 14 March and is known as the republic's shortest-serving minister. In the Winter War, as the Commander-in-Chief's chief of the general staff, he applied the defence plans he had drawn up before the war; near the end he also had to act as a front commander, took over the Coastal Group and stabilised the front in the last days. Between the Winter War and the Continuation War he led the II army group at Lahti.

heading.zh-Hant: 繼續戰爭：維堡、斯維爾與卡累利阿地峽
heading.en: Continuation War: Viipuri, the Svir and the Karelian Isthmus

body.zh-Hant: 據BLF，繼續戰爭進攻階段他指揮卡累利阿地峽的第四軍團，部隊以快速渡過維堡灣的『雙側封鎖』殲滅面前三個蘇軍師，並奪回維堡。1942年他調往彼得羅扎沃茨克任卡累利阿軍（後稱奧努斯集群）司令，首要任務是擊退斯維爾河畔的春季泥濘期攻勢。1944年6月蘇軍大攻勢時，曼納海姆命令他接掌地峽上兩個軍團，在塔利—伊哈恩塔拉戰役中遏阻蘇軍攻勢。6月26日他獲頒曼納海姆十字勳章。
body.en: According to the BLF, in the offensive phase of the Continuation War he commanded IV Army Corps on the Karelian Isthmus, whose 'bilateral blockade', based on a rapid crossing of Viipuri Bay, destroyed the three Soviet divisions facing it, and Viipuri was retaken under his leadership. In 1942 he was transferred to Petrozavodsk as commander of the Karelian Army, later the Aunus Group, his first task being to repel the enemy's thaw-season attack on the Svir. When the great Soviet offensive began in June 1944 Mannerheim ordered him to take command of the corps on the Karelian Isthmus, and at the battle of Tali-Ihantala the Russian offensive was broken. He received the Mannerheim Cross on 26 June 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後審判與晚年
heading.en: Postwar trial and later life

body.zh-Hant: 戰後奧伊什因戰犯指控受審：他在1941年9月的一道命令要求芬蘭戰俘營對拒絕服從的蘇聯戰俘開槍，蘇聯要求逮捕他。他於1945年10月被捕，被判12年徒刑，最高法院減為3年；1948年獲釋。他於1945年9月10日退出現役，1978年3月28日逝世。
body.en: After the war Oesch was tried for war crimes: in an order of September 1941 he had told Finnish POW camps to shoot Soviet prisoners who refused to obey, and the Soviet Union demanded his arrest. He was arrested in October 1945, sentenced to 12 years, reduced by the Supreme Court to 3 years, and released in 1948. He left active service on 10 September 1945 and died on 28 March 1978.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、獵兵運動與1918年內戰
heading.en: Origins, the Jäger movement and the 1918 war

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭瑞典語傳記辭典（BLF）條目，埃里克·海因里克斯1890年7月21日生於赫爾辛基，早年在報社擔任編輯與編輯祕書。他追隨兄弟的榜樣前往德國參加獵兵運動，並隨獵兵主力在1918年2月25日返回芬蘭，在內戰中站在白軍一方，並以營長身分參與攻占維堡。
body.en: According to the Biografiskt lexikon för Finland (BLF), Erik Heinrichs was born in Helsinki on 21 July 1890 and worked as an editor and editorial secretary for newspapers. Following his brothers' example he went to Germany for the Jäger movement, returned to Finland with the main body of Jägers on 25 February 1918, fought on the White side in the civil war and took part in the capture of Vyborg as a battalion commander.

heading.zh-Hant: 兩次大戰之間與冬季戰爭
heading.en: The interwar years and the Winter War

body.zh-Hant: 1924年奧斯卡·恩克爾被迫去職後，海因里克斯被任命為代理參謀長；他在1925至1928年於巴黎法國高等軍事學院進修，1929至1931年任戰爭學院院長。冬季戰爭爆發時，少將海因里克斯出任第三軍團司令，在泰帕萊地段的戰役中作戰成功，隨後接替被迫去職的休戈·厄斯特曼，出任卡累利阿地峽軍司令。
body.en: After Oscar Enckell was forced to resign in 1924, Heinrichs was appointed acting chief of the general staff; he studied at the French war college in Paris in 1925–1928 and headed the War College in 1929–1931. When the Winter War broke out, Major General Heinrichs became commander of III Army Corps and led it successfully on the Taipale sector, after which he succeeded General Hugo Österman, who had unexpectedly been forced to resign, as head of the Army of the Karelian Isthmus.

body.zh-Hant: 據同一條目，海因里克斯1940年5月出任參謀總長，但作戰規劃與指揮仍由軍需總監艾羅負責，他主要處理與德國的聯絡事務。繼續戰爭開始時，總司令在1941年任命他為卡累利阿軍司令，任務是奪回拉多加卡累利阿並推進到拉多加與奧涅加湖之間的斯維里防線；他表現成功，10月初晉升步兵上將。1942年1月，總司令再度任命他為參謀總長。
body.en: According to the same entry, Heinrichs became chief of the general staff in May 1940, but responsibility for operational planning and command stayed with Quartermaster General Airo, and he mainly handled relations with Germany. When the Continuation War began, the Commander-in-Chief appointed him in 1941 commander of the Karelian Army, tasked with reconquering Ladoga Karelia and advancing to the isthmus between Ladoga and Onega, the Svir line; he again proved successful and was promoted general of infantry in early October. In January 1942 the Commander-in-Chief once more appointed him chief of the general staff.

heading.zh-Hant: 1942–1945年：參謀總長與國防軍司令

body.zh-Hant: 1942年2月海因里克斯獲頒曼納海姆十字勳章二級。1944年10月他被任命為主參謀部（huvudstaben）首長；1944至1945年之交曼納海姆就任總統，海因里克斯成為國防軍司令。由於所謂武器隱匿事件，他在1945年夏天必須辭職，任期很短。
body.en: In February 1942 Heinrichs was awarded the Mannerheim Cross, 2nd class. In October 1944 he was appointed chief of the main staff (huvudstaben), and when Mannerheim became president at the turn of 1944–1945, Heinrichs became commander of the Defence Forces. Because of the affair of the so-called weapons caches he had to resign in the summer of 1945, so his tenure was short.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、獵兵時期與1918年卡累利阿戰線
heading.en: Origins, the Jäger years and the 1918 Karelian front

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭瑞典語傳記辭典（BLF）條目，阿爾內·西赫沃1889年生於韋德拉克斯（Virolahti），1915年3月隨最早一批人前往德國受軍事訓練，獵兵時期包括招募與間諜任務。1918年內戰中，他在卡累利阿戰線的戰役裡指揮薩伊馬湖與拉多加湖之間的戰線，卡累利阿集團軍守住了武奧克西河以南的陣地，保護了白軍左翼，也為攻取維堡奠定戰略位置，使他成為白軍的民族英雄。
body.en: According to the Biografiskt lexikon för Finland (BLF), Aarne Sihvo was born in 1889 at Vederlax (Virolahti) and went to Germany for military training among the very first in March 1915; his Jäger years included recruiting and espionage trips. In the 1918 civil war he commanded the Karelian front between Lake Saimaa and Lake Ladoga; the Karelian Army Group held its positions south of the Vuoksi, securing the White army's left flank and a good strategic starting point for the conquest of Viipuri, which made him a national hero of the White side.

heading.zh-Hant: 1918至1926年：離軍、議員與阿魯努斯遠征
heading.en: 1918–1926: leaving the army, parliament and the Aunus expedition

body.zh-Hant: 內戰後西赫沃被任命為第3師師長，但只任職數月，1918年秋天因無法適應當時親德的路線而離開軍隊，並成為共和制的明確支持者。1919年他代表民族進步黨在卡累利阿參選國會議員，在選區得票最高；同年又領導遠征奧洛涅茨卡累利阿（阿魯努斯），1920年離開國會。1920年代初他在法國與義大利受軍事教育，1924年起出任新設戰爭學院的首任院長。
body.en: After the war Sihvo was appointed commander of the 3rd Division but served only a few months; he left the army in autumn 1918 because he could not adapt to the prevailing German orientation, and became an outspoken republican. In 1919 he stood for the National Progressive Party in Karelia in the parliamentary election and received the largest vote in his constituency; the same year he led the expedition to Olonets Karelia (Aunus) and he left parliament in 1920. In the early 1920s he received military education in France and Italy and from 1924 he served as the first head of Finland's War College.

heading.zh-Hant: 1926至1933年：國防軍司令與馬恩特薩拉叛亂
heading.en: 1926–1933: commander of the armed forces and the Mäntsälä rebellion

body.zh-Hant: 1926年夏天，總統雷蘭德任命西赫沃為國防軍司令，這是獵兵運動確立地位的具體高峰。1926年12月社會民主黨接掌政府後，他所領導的軍隊與其合作的態度在資產階級圈中顯得可疑，並因勞科拉事件而聲望受損。1932年春天，他對馬恩特薩拉叛亂採取強硬立場，主張以強力手段制止違抗政府的護衛團成員，因此與護衛團領導層及許多軍官發生衝突，1933年初被解除國防軍司令職務。
body.en: In summer 1926 President L. K. Relander appointed Sihvo commander of the armed forces, a concrete high point of the Jäger movement's aspirations. His army's cooperation with the Social Democrats, who took over the government in December 1926, looked suspect on the bourgeois side, and his position was undermined by the Laukola affair. His uncompromising stance on the Mäntsälä rebellion in spring 1932, when he urged hard measures against the Civil Guard men defying the government, brought him into conflict with the Civil Guard leadership and many leading officers, and he was dismissed from command of the armed forces in early 1933.

heading.zh-Hant: 1933至1953年：總監、民防與戰後國防軍司令
heading.en: 1933–1953: inspector, civil defence and postwar commander

body.zh-Hant: 1933年1月西赫沃出任國防部的總監，失去所有影響力；1938年秋天國防部長尼烏卡寧任命他為全國民防首長，他在冬季戰爭期間領導民防組織。繼續戰爭爆發時他是總司令部的防空司令。戰後他在1946至1953年出任國防軍司令，並引導軍隊走帕西基維總統的路線。芬蘭瑞典語百科Uppslagsverket Finland則記載他自1946年起為步兵上將、1938至1946年任民防首長。
body.en: In January 1933 Sihvo was appointed inspector general in the Ministry of Defence, losing all influence; in autumn 1938 Defence Minister Juho Niukkanen appointed him head of civil defence, which he led during the Winter War. At the outbreak of the Continuation War he served as anti-aircraft commander at Headquarters. After the wars he was commander of the Defence Forces in 1946–1953 and steered the army onto President Paasikivi's line. Uppslagsverket Finland additionally records him as general of infantry from 1946 and head of civil defence in 1938–1946.

body.en: According to the BLF entry, Adolf Ehrnrooth was born in Helsinki on 9 February 1905 into a family of officers and saw the military career as a calling. In December 1922 he was posted to the Cadet School in Helsinki and returned to his former unit as a cornet; from August 1928 he took a one-year course at the Army Riding School at Strömsholm Castle in Sweden. After the War College he served as bureau chief on the staff of the Cavalry Brigade.

body.zh-Hant: 冬季戰爭期間，埃恩魯特先在卡累利阿地峽西側擔任作戰處長，1940年1月10日被任命為第7師參謀長，負責從拉多加到薩科拉的主防線左翼；泰帕萊與蘇萬托的防線守住。和約後他繼續任該師參謀長，到9月晉升少校並轉任東薩沃拉克斯軍區參謀長。繼續戰爭中，1941年7月1日他率領兩個營又兩個連的戰鬥群進攻時身負重傷，傷癒花了超過半年，1942年1月重返部隊。
body.en: In the Winter War Ehrnrooth first served on the western Karelian Isthmus as chief of the operations section, and on 10 January 1940 he was appointed chief of staff of the 7th Division, responsible for the left flank of the main defence line from Ladoga to Sakkola; at Taipale and Suvanto the defence held. After the peace he continued as the division's chief of staff until September, when he was promoted major and became chief of staff of the Eastern Savo military province. In the Continuation War he was severely wounded on 1 July 1941 leading a combat group of two battalions and two companies, took over half a year to recover, and returned to the ranks in January 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 第7步兵團團長與1944年夏季防禦戰
heading.en: Commander of Infantry Regiment 7 and the summer 1944 defensive battles

body.zh-Hant: 1942年5月埃恩魯特出任第7步兵團團長，當時37歲，是迄今最年輕的步兵團團長。他的部隊在1944年夏季於錫拉馬基、艾里佩與武奧薩爾米的防禦戰中取得成功，蘇軍大攻勢最終在此被阻止。1944年12月4日，總司令授予上校埃恩魯特曼納海姆十字勳章；RUL簡歷列為騎士第162號，並載明他1942至1944年任第7步兵團團長。
body.en: In May 1942 Ehrnrooth was appointed commander of Infantry Regiment 7; he was 37 and the youngest man yet appointed to command an infantry regiment. His unit succeeded in the defensive battles of summer 1944 at Siiramäki, Äyräpää and Vuosalmi, where the Soviet offensive was finally halted. On 4 December 1944 the Commander-in-Chief made Colonel Ehrnrooth a Knight of the Mannerheim Cross; the RUL record lists him as knight no. 162 and gives his command of Infantry Regiment 7 as 1942–1944.

heading.en: Postwar commands and later life

body.zh-Hant: 戰後埃恩魯特出任拉彭蘭塔（Villmanstrand）的尼蘭龍騎兵團團長，1952年春起任新設的裝甲團團長，1956年被任命為防空檢查官；1965年他以中將身分卸下第2師師長，轉入預備役。此後三十年他成為備受敬重的公共發言人，是整整一代戰爭老兵的象徵。他2004年2月26日逝於土庫。
body.en: After the war Ehrnrooth was appointed commander of the Nyland Dragoon Regiment at Lappeenranta, from spring 1952 he led the newly established Armoured Regiment at Parola, and in 1956 he was appointed inspector of air defence; in 1965 he passed to the reserve as a lieutenant general, leaving the command of the 2nd Division. For the next three decades he was a visible public voice and a respected figurehead for a whole generation of war veterans. He died in Turku on 26 February 2004.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、獵兵運動與1918年維堡
heading.en: Origins, the Jäger movement and Viipuri in 1918

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭瑞典語傳記辭典（BLF）條目，哈拉爾德·厄奎斯特1891年3月1日生於赫爾辛基，1914年在赫爾辛基大學通過法律考試，是戰前即擁有學位的少數獵兵之一。他是最早的志願者之一，1915年2月中旬已在柏林接待並引導新兵。1918年2月初他奉派率獵兵先遣隊前往芬蘭，月底組建第9薩沃—卡累利阿獵兵營，並在攻取維堡的戰役中擔任營長。
body.en: According to the Biografiskt lexikon för Finland (BLF), Harald Öhquist was born in Helsinki on 1 March 1891 and passed the law examination at the University of Helsinki in 1914, one of the few Jägers with an academic degree before the First World War. He was among the first volunteers and in mid-February 1915 was already receiving and guiding new recruits in Berlin. In early February 1918 he was ordered to lead the Jägers' advance party to Finland, at the end of that month founded the volunteer 9th Savo-Karelian Jäger Battalion, and commanded it in the fighting for the conquest of Viipuri.

heading.zh-Hant: 1918至1939年：卡累利阿地峽的守護者
heading.en: 1918–1939: defender of Viipuri and the Karelian Isthmus

body.zh-Hant: 戰後厄奎斯特把畢生事業放在卡累利阿：先任卡累利阿近衛團團長，接著任第2師師長，最後任奉命擔任掩護部隊的軍團長，被稱為「維堡城堡之主」。Uppslagsverket Finland記載這三個任期依序是1918至1925年、1925至1934年與1934至1939年，後兩者的司令部都在維堡。他於1936年晉升中將，並長期研究卡累利阿地峽的防禦，發展出自己的「地峽作戰學說」。
body.en: After the war Öhquist did his central life's work in Karelia: first as commander of the Karelian Guards Regiment, then of the 2nd Division, and finally of the army corps ordered to act as a covering force; he was called the 'lord of the castle of Viipuri'. Uppslagsverket Finland gives these tenures as 1918–25, 1925–34 and 1934–39, the latter two based at Viipuri. He was promoted lieutenant general in 1936 and over a couple of decades developed his own 'combat doctrine for the Isthmus'.

heading.zh-Hant: 冬季戰爭與繼續戰爭
heading.en: The Winter War and the Continuation War

body.zh-Hant: 1939年冬季戰爭爆發時，厄奎斯特奉命指揮卡累利阿地峽西部的軍團，在這場戰役中那裡正是敵軍主攻方向。BLF指出，對方在數量與物資上的優勢使他無法充分運用和平時期擬定的防禦計畫，他與上級卡累利阿地峽軍司令休戈·厄斯特曼也不易相處。繼續戰爭初期他被派為駐德國陸軍總部的聯絡將領，1942年被召回出任地峽軍團長；Uppslagsverket Finland記載他1942年1月至1944年3月擔任地峽集團軍司令。1944年3月他被調離前線，轉往總司令部。
body.en: When the Winter War broke out in 1939, Öhquist was ordered to command the army corps in the western part of the Karelian Isthmus, the enemy's main axis of attack. The BLF says the enemy's numerical and material superiority prevented him from making full use of his peacetime defence plans, and that he had difficulty getting along with his immediate superior, the head of the Army of the Karelian Isthmus, Hugo Österman. At the start of the Continuation War he was posted as Finnish liaison general to the German army headquarters and in 1942 was recalled to head the corps on the Karelian Isthmus; Uppslagsverket Finland records him as commander of the army group on the Isthmus from January 1942 to March 1944. In March 1944 he was moved from the front to Headquarters.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後職務與評價
heading.en: Postwar service and assessment

body.zh-Hant: 1944年春他出任軍事教育總監，一直任職到1951年退出現役，之後又在赫爾辛基從事七年的民防工作。1946年夏天尋找新的國防軍司令時，他的名字再度被提起，但總統帕西基維與總理佩卡拉認為「厄奎斯特的神經撐不住」。1950年赫爾辛基大學授予他榮譽博士，他於1971年2月10日在赫爾辛基去世。
body.en: In spring 1944 he became inspector general of military training, serving until his retirement from active service in 1951; afterwards he spent seven years on various civil-defence tasks in Helsinki. In summer 1946 his name came up again in the search for a new commander of the Defence Forces, but President Paasikivi and Prime Minister Pekkala judged that his nerves would not hold. The University of Helsinki gave him an honorary doctorate in 1950 and he died in Helsinki on 10 February 1971.
